views.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent three-hex tactical game building sprite.
Input image 1: GEOMETRY AND CAMERA guide. Its straight four-bay factory is the exact plan and fixed high-camera projection to render. Hexes and dots are alignment guides only.
Input image 2: EDIT TARGET / appearance reference: preserve this particular textile factory's masonry, fine grey slate tiles, four industrial saw-tooth roof bays, blue-grey northlight glazing, pale stone corner buttresses, downpipes, arched end doorway and one cylindrical stone chimney.
Change only the camera/ground projection of image 2 to match image 1. Its current long axis is too steep and cannot fit the game's three hexes. Redraw the same building with its long axis running lower left to upper right, with a rise/run of exactly 2/3 (33.7 degrees to the horizontal), as shown by image 1. Use a HIGH, roof-dominant fixed orthographic camera. Shallow visible masonry walls. Do not tilt or rotate a finished bitmap: vertical walls and the cylindrical chimney must still rise straight towards screen top. Four connected saw-tooth bays share the same width, slope and roof direction. Keep the single chimney at the upper-right end.
Make the footprint slim as in image 1. The complete building must stay within the three guide hexes, and its connected roof/body must cross the exact center of all three hexes. Preserve the detailed hand-painted game-art finish of image 2; do not simplify to flat colors. No invented wings, no extra buildings, no normal house gable roof.
Output only ONE complete isolated factory at this orientation on a genuinely transparent background. No hex grid, center dots, labels, ground, text, frame or cast shadow. Leave a transparent margin around the entire silhouette including chimney. Landscape composition. Do not include any reference inset.

refined_60.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Create one production game sprite by painting ONLY the large factory silhouette in this reference. The small top-left inset is a materials/style reference and must not appear in the output. Follow the LARGE construction drawing exactly: same four slim connected saw-tooth roof bays, same high overhead camera, same shallow wall strips, same axis and bay corner coordinates, same upper-right cylindrical chimney. The roof must follow the three hex centers along a shallow lower-left to upper-right diagonal. Do not copy the steeper angle or tall walls from the tiny inset. Add the inset's detailed grey slate tiles, pale stone walls, buttresses, downpipes, blue-grey industrial roof glass and doorway to the large construction drawing while keeping the construction silhouette and all four roof corners of every bay fixed. Keep the long axis at 33.7 degrees to horizontal. This is the same textile factory as the inset, reprojected for the hex map. No house gable roofs. Render fine hand-painted outlined game art, not flat colors. The hex grid and yellow dots are guides: the building must fit inside the combined three hexes and cross all three yellow dots. Remove every guide, inset, label and background from the final output. Output ONLY the one complete detailed factory, with a genuinely transparent background and transparent margin. No floor, glow, shadow, vignette or presentation background. Keep chimney vertical in screen space. Wide landscape image.
